# fptcloud_alert_notification_methods (Data Source)

Lists the notification methods configured for a VPC. Use it to fill `notification_method_ids` on a backup job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_vpc" "this" {
  name = "your_vpc_name"
}

data "fptcloud_alert_notification_methods" "email" {
  vpc_id = data.fptcloud_vpc.this.id
  type   = "EMAIL"
}

# Match on address, not name: the API groups methods by address, so the name of
# two methods sharing an address is not stable.
output "email_channels" {
  value = [for m in data.fptcloud_alert_notification_methods.email.methods : m.address]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC.

### Optional

- `level` (String) The scope of the notification methods: `VPC` or `PROJECT`.
- `type` (String) Only return methods of this channel type, for example `EMAIL`. Webhook methods are never returned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `methods` (List of Object) The notification methods found. Match on `address`, not `name`: the API groups results by address, so `name` is not stable when two methods share an address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--methods))

<a id="nestedatt--methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `methods`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `level` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
